<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="wutong-logo.svg" />
    <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="wutong-logo.svg?v=2" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
    <title>梧桐智能体互联平台</title>
    <style>
        :root {
            --primary: #3b6ff6;
            --primary-light: #e8eeff;
            --border: #e8eaef;
            --text: #1a1d28;
            --text-secondary: #6b7280;
            --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
            --shadow-md: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
            --radius: 12px;
            --radius-sm: 8px;
            --sidebar-width: 1000px;
            --agent-card-min: 128px;
        }
        * { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
        body {
            font-family: "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", sans-serif;
            background: #f0f2f7;
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.6;
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }
        .header {
            height: 64px;
            background: #fff;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 0 28px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 100;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }
        .header-left {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            min-width: 0;
        }
        .logo-icon {
            width: 38px;
            height: 38px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            object-fit: contain;   /* 让图片完整显示在框内 */
            background: #fff;      /* 如果 logo 是深色的，可以保留白色背景；如果想保留原来的蓝色渐变，改成 linear-gradient(135deg, #3b6ff6, #5b8af7) */
            padding: 1px;          /* 可选，让图标不贴边 */
            margin-top: -2px; 
        }
        .logo-text { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; }
        .logo-text span { color: var(--primary); }
        .header-contributor {
            position: relative;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            margin-left: 6px;
            margin-top: 6px;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--primary);
            cursor: pointer;
            white-space: nowrap;
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .header-contributor-popup {
            position: absolute;
            top: calc(100% + 18px);
            left: 0;
            width: 360px;
            max-width: min(82vw, 420px);
            padding: 14px 16px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            background: rgba(26, 29, 40, 0.96);
            color: #fff;
            box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            transform: translateY(6px);
            transition: opacity 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease;
            z-index: 120;
        }
        .header-contributor:hover .header-contributor-popup {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }
        .header-contributor-title {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #cdd8ff;
            margin: 10px 0 6px;
        }
        .header-contributor-title:first-child {
            margin-top: 0;
        }
        .header-contributor-line {
            font-size: 12px;
            line-height: 1.65;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
        }
        .header-contributor-names {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 4px 10px;
            font-size: 12px;
            line-height: 1.65;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
        }
        .header-contributor-empty {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.56);
        }
        .header-badge {
            padding: 6px 14px;
            background: var(--primary-light);
            color: var(--primary);
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        .container {
            display: flex;
            padding: 22px 24px;
            gap: 12px;
            max-width: 1440px;
            width: 100%;
            margin: 0 auto;
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            align-items: flex-start;
        }
        .main {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 0;
            min-height: 0;
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding-right: 8px;
        }
        .sidebar {
            width: var(--sidebar-width);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            height: calc(100vh - 64px - 44px);
            min-height: 640px;
            background: #fff;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .sidebar-topbar {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 12px 14px 10px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f8fbff 100%);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .sidebar-title-wrap {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            min-width: 0;
        }
        .sidebar-title {
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .sidebar-corner-tools {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-left: auto;
            position: relative;
        }
        .sidebar-help-wrap {
            position: relative;
            display: inline-flex;
        }
        .sidebar-help {
            position: relative;
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 1px solid #bfd0f4;
            background: #eef4ff;
            color: var(--primary);
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
            box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(59, 111, 246, 0.08);
            appearance: none;
        }
        .sidebar-help:focus-visible {
            outline: 2px solid rgba(59, 111, 246, 0.4);
            outline-offset: 2px;
        }
        .sidebar-help-popup {
            position: absolute;
            top: calc(100% + 12px);
            right: 0;
            left: auto;
            width: 290px;
            padding: 14px;
            border-radius: 14px;
            background: rgba(21, 27, 40, 0.97);
            color: #fff;
            box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.24);
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            transform: translateY(6px);
            transition: opacity 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease;
            z-index: 140;
        }
        .sidebar-help-popup::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 100%;
            width: 64px;
            height: 14px;
        }
        .sidebar-help-wrap.is-open .sidebar-help-popup,
        .sidebar-help-wrap:hover .sidebar-help-popup,
        .sidebar-help-wrap:focus-within .sidebar-help-popup {
            opacity: 1;
            pointer-events: auto;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }
        .sidebar-help-item + .sidebar-help-item {
            margin-top: 12px;
            padding-top: 12px;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
        }
        .sidebar-help-name {
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #cdd8ff;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }
        .sidebar-help-desc {
            font-size: 12px;
            line-height: 1.55;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.86);
        }
        .sidebar-help-link {
            display: inline-block;
            margin-top: 6px;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #8fb4ff;
            text-decoration: none;
        }
        .sidebar-help-link:hover {
            text-decoration: underline;
        }
        .docs-link {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            padding: 6px 10px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 999px;
            color: var(--text-light);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 12px;
            transition: color 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease;
        }
        .docs-link:hover {
            color: var(--primary);
            border-color: rgba(59, 111, 246, 0.35);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(59, 111, 246, 0.12);
        }
        .header-right {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            gap: 10px;
            min-width: 0;
        }
        .active-agent-count {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            padding: 6px 10px;
            border: 1px solid #dbe7ff;
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: #f7faff;
            color: #53657d;
            font-size: 12px;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .active-agent-count::before {
            content: "";
            width: 7px;
            height: 7px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: #22c55e;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(34,197,94,.12);
        }
        .active-agent-count strong { color: #172033; font-size: 13px; }
        .online-query {
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            width: min(310px, 31vw);
            height: 34px;
            padding-left: 12px;
            border: 1px solid #dce3ef;
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: #fff;
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(31,49,83,.05);
            transition: border-color .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
        }
        .online-query:focus-within {
            border-color: rgba(59,111,246,.55);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59,111,246,.1);
        }
        .online-query-input {
            width: 100%;
            min-width: 0;
            border: 0;
            outline: 0;
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--text);
            font: inherit;
            font-size: 12px;
        }
        .online-query-input::placeholder { color: #9aa4b2; }
        .online-query-button {
            align-self: stretch;
            flex: 0 0 auto;
            padding: 0 13px;
            border: 0;
            border-left: 1px solid #e8edf5;
            border-radius: 0 999px 999px 0;
            background: #f5f8ff;
            color: var(--primary);
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .online-query-button:hover { background: #eaf1ff; }
        .online-query-button:disabled { color: #94a3b8; cursor: wait; background: #f8fafc; }
        .online-query-result {
            position: absolute;
            top: calc(100% + 10px);
            right: 0;
            z-index: 160;
            width: min(360px, 88vw);
            padding: 13px 14px;
            border: 1px solid #e1e7f0;
            border-radius: 12px;
            background: #fff;
            color: #53657d;
            box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(24,39,75,.18);
            font-size: 12px;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }
        .online-query-result[hidden] { display: none; }
        .online-query-result strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 3px; color: #1e293b; font-size: 13px; }
        .online-query-result.error { border-color: #fecaca; background: #fff8f8; color: #b42318; }
        .online-query-result.error strong { color: #b42318; }
        .online-query-result.empty { border-color: #dbe7ff; background: #f8fbff; }
        .online-query-result.success { border-color: #bbf7d0; background: #f4fff8; color: #15803d; }
        .online-query-result.success strong { color: #15803d; }
        .online-query-result.offline { border-color: #fed7aa; background: #fffaf3; color: #b45309; }
        .online-query-result.offline strong { color: #b45309; }
        .resize-handle {
            width: 10px;
            flex: 0 0 10px;
            align-self: stretch;
            cursor: col-resize;
            position: relative;
            border-radius: 999px;
            touch-action: none;
        }
        .resize-handle::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            top: 10px;
            bottom: 10px;
            left: 4px;
            width: 2px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: #cfd5df;
            transition: background 0.2s, width 0.2s, left 0.2s;
        }
        .resize-handle:hover::before,
        body.resizing-sidebar .resize-handle::before {
            left: 3px;
            width: 4px;
            background: var(--primary);
        }
        body.resizing-sidebar {
            cursor: col-resize;
            user-select: none;
        }
        body.resizing-sidebar iframe {
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .search-section {
            background: #fff;
            padding: 16px 20px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            gap: 12px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }
        .search-section input {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 10px 0;
            border: none;
            outline: none;
            font-size: 15px;
            background: transparent;
        }
        .section-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin: 8px 0 14px;
        }
        .section-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
        .section-title2 { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
        .icon-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; }
        .icon-dot.new { background: #f59e0b; }
        .icon-dot.hot { background: #ef4444; }
        .refresh-btn {
            font-size: 12px; color: var(--primary); background: var(--primary-light);
            border: none; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer;
        }
        .refresh-btn:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: .55; }
        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
            gap: 10px;
            margin: 0;
            min-height: 0;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 3;
        }
        .dashboard-section {
            margin-bottom: 14px;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 16px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,.9);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }
        .store-heading {
            margin: 22px 4px 10px;
            color: #263244;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 750;
            line-height: 1.35;
            letter-spacing: -.01em;
        }
        .store-section .section-toggle-title {
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .store-section .section-toggle-desc { font-size: 10px; }
        .dashboard-section.ranking-section {
            border-color: #d7e4ff;
            background: linear-gradient(145deg, #fff 0%, #f7faff 100%);
            box-shadow: 0 9px 26px rgba(59,111,246,.09);
        }
        .dashboard-section-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            min-height: 52px;
            padding: 9px 12px;
        }
        .section-toggle {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 9px;
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 0;
            padding: 0;
            border: 0;
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--text);
            text-align: left;
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .section-toggle-copy { min-width: 0; }
        .section-toggle-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 750; line-height: 1.35; }
        .section-toggle-desc {
            display: block;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-top: 1px;
            color: #8993a4;
            font-size: 10px;
            line-height: 1.35;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .section-chevron {
            flex: 0 0 auto;
            width: 22px;
            height: 22px;
            border-radius: 7px;
            background: #f1f5fb;
            color: #718096;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 12px;
            transition: transform .2s ease;
        }
        .dashboard-section.is-collapsed .section-chevron { transform: rotate(-90deg); }
        .dashboard-section.is-collapsed .section-body { display: none; }
        .section-body { padding: 0 12px 12px; }
        .section-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
        .rank-role-select {
            max-width: 106px;
            height: 28px;
            padding: 0 24px 0 8px;
            border: 1px solid #dae3f2;
            border-radius: 9px;
            background: #fff;
            color: #465264;
            font-size: 11px;
            outline: none;
        }
        .ranking-meta {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 9px;
            color: #8a94a5;
            font-size: 10px;
            line-height: 1.45;
        }
        .ranking-meta-status { text-align: right; }
        .ranking-meta-status.warning { color: #b45309; }
        .ranking-list {
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 1px solid #e1e8f5;
            border-radius: 12px;
            background: #fff;
        }
        .ranking-list-head,
        .ranking-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 34px minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 9px;
        }
        .ranking-list-head {
            min-height: 30px;
            padding: 5px 10px;
            background: #f6f8fc;
            color: #8b95a5;
            font-size: 9px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .ranking-list-head span:last-child { text-align: right; }
        .ranking-row {
            min-height: 54px;
            padding: 7px 10px;
            border-top: 1px solid #edf1f6;
            transition: background .18s ease;
        }
        .ranking-row:hover { background: #f8faff; }
        .ranking-row.rank-1 { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fffaf0 0%, #fff 48%); }
        .ranking-row.rank-2 { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f8fafc 0%, #fff 48%); }
        .ranking-row.rank-3 { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fff8f4 0%, #fff 48%); }
        .ranking-position {
            width: 26px;
            height: 26px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: #edf3ff;
            color: var(--primary);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 800;
        }
        .rank-1 .ranking-position { background: #f7d774; color: #6f4b00; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(202,145,0,.18); }
        .rank-2 .ranking-position { background: #dfe5ed; color: #53606f; }
        .rank-3 .ranking-position { background: #e7b691; color: #704221; }
        .ranking-main { min-width: 0; }
        .ranking-count { color: #172033; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
        .ranking-unit { margin-left: 3px; color: #8b95a5; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; }
        .ranking-aic {
            overflow: hidden;
            color: #344054;
            font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            line-height: 1.4;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .ranking-sources { margin-top: 2px; color: #98a2b3; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.3; }
        .ranking-pagination {
            min-height: 42px;
            padding: 7px 10px;
            border-top: 1px solid #e8edf5;
            background: #fafbfd;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 10px;
        }
        .ranking-page-info {
            color: #7f8a9c;
            font-size: 10px;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .ranking-page-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
        .ranking-page-button {
            height: 27px;
            padding: 0 10px;
            border: 1px solid #dbe3f0;
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: #fff;
            color: #465264;
            font-size: 10px;
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .ranking-page-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
            color: var(--primary);
            border-color: #bfd0f4;
            background: #f3f7ff;
        }
        .ranking-page-button:disabled {
            cursor: not-allowed;
            color: #b0b7c3;
            background: #f4f6f9;
        }
        .ranking-state {
            min-height: 112px;
            padding: 18px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: #8792a4;
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 11px;
            line-height: 1.65;
        }
        .ranking-state strong { color: #53657d; font-size: 12px; }
        .cloud-section {
            margin-top: 6px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        .cloud-wrap {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            height: 360px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(88, 132, 255, 0.22);
            background:
                radial-gradient(circle at 18% 22%, rgba(47, 152, 255, 0.18), transparent 24%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 76% 18%, rgba(148, 87, 255, 0.18), transparent 26%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 72% 72%, rgba(27, 223, 201, 0.12), transparent 24%),
                linear-gradient(135deg, #07152e 0%, #0d2b67 38%, #32227c 72%, #4e1f86 100%);
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05), 0 16px 36px rgba(10, 20, 58, 0.22);
        }
        .cloud-wrap.has-bg-image {
            background:
                var(--cloud-bg-image),
                radial-gradient(circle at 18% 22%, rgba(47, 152, 255, 0.18), transparent 24%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 76% 18%, rgba(148, 87, 255, 0.18), transparent 26%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 72% 72%, rgba(27, 223, 201, 0.12), transparent 24%),
                linear-gradient(135deg, #07152e 0%, #0d2b67 38%, #32227c 72%, #4e1f86 100%);
            background-size: cover, auto, auto, auto, auto;
            background-position: center center, 0 0, 0 0, 0 0, 0 0;
            background-blend-mode: screen, screen, screen, screen, normal;
        }
        .cloud-wrap::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background:
                radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(121, 214, 255, 0.18), transparent 26%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(121, 214, 255, 0.09), transparent 42%),
                repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(138, 215, 255, 0.08) 0 1px, transparent 1px 28px);
            opacity: 0.9;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .cloud-wrap::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background:

            function getNodePosition(index, total, width, height) {
                const presets = [
                    [0.17, 0.22], [0.34, 0.16], [0.52, 0.12], [0.73, 0.18],
                    [0.86, 0.31], [0.78, 0.56], [0.64, 0.8], [0.44, 0.84],
                    [0.22, 0.72], [0.12, 0.5], [0.28, 0.38], [0.58, 0.48]
                ];
                const [px, py] = presets[index % presets.length];
                const driftX = Math.sin(index * 1.9) * Math.min(18, width * 0.018);
                const driftY = Math.cos(index * 1.4) * Math.min(14, height * 0.024);
                return {
                    x: width * px + driftX,

            function renderAgentCloud() {
                if (!$cloudWrap || !$cloudCanvas || !$cloudNodes) return;

                cloudAgents = getCloudAgents();
                const width = $cloudWrap.clientWidth;
                const height = $cloudWrap.clientHeight;
                if (!width || !height) return;

                const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
                $cloudCanvas.width = Math.floor(width * dpr);
                $cloudCanvas.height = Math.floor(height * dpr);
                $cloudCanvas.style.width = `${width}px`;
                $cloudCanvas.style.height = `${height}px`;

                const ctx = $cloudCanvas.getContext('2d');
                ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
                ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

                const positions = cloudAgents.map((agent, index) => ({
                    agent,
                    ...getNodePosition(index, cloudAgents.length, width, height)
                }));
                const nodeRadius = 23;

                const center = { x: width / 2, y: height * 0.52 };

                const meshGradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(center.x, center.y, 10, center.x, center.y, Math.max(width, height) * 0.48);
                meshGradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(121, 218, 255, 0.14)');
                meshGradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(121, 218, 255, 0)');
                ctx.fillStyle = meshGradient;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(center.x, center.y, Math.max(width, height) * 0.42, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();

                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(118, 213, 255, 0.12)';
                ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                [0.18, 0.28, 0.38, 0.48].forEach((ratio) => {
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.ellipse(center.x, center.y, width * ratio, height * (ratio * 0.5), 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.stroke();
                });

                const edgeSet = new Set();
                const degreeMap = new Map(positions.map((_, index) => [index, 0]));
                const pairDistances = [];

                for (let i = 0; i < positions.length; i += 1) {
                    for (let j = i + 1; j < positions.length; j += 1) {
                        const dx = positions[j].x - positions[i].x;
                        const dy = positions[j].y - positions[i].y;
                        pairDistances.push({
                            i,
                            j,
                            distance: Math.hypot(dx, dy)
                        });
                    }
                }

                const sortedPairs = pairDistances.sort((a, b) => a.distance - b.distance);
                const edges = [];
                const maxDistance = Math.min(width, height) * 0.72;

                function addEdge(edge) {
                    if (edge.distance > maxDistance) return false;
                    const key = `${edge.i}-${edge.j}`;
                    if (edgeSet.has(key)) return false;
                    edgeSet.add(key);
                    edges.push(edge);
                    degreeMap.set(edge.i, (degreeMap.get(edge.i) || 0) + 1);
                    degreeMap.set(edge.j, (degreeMap.get(edge.j) || 0) + 1);
                    return true;
                }

                sortedPairs.forEach((edge) => {
                    const sourceDegree = degreeMap.get(edge.i) || 0;
                    const targetDegree = degreeMap.get(edge.j) || 0;
                    if (sourceDegree < 2 || targetDegree < 2) {
                        addEdge(edge);
                    }
                });

                sortedPairs.forEach((edge) => {
                    const sourceDegree = degreeMap.get(edge.i) || 0;
                    const targetDegree = degreeMap.get(edge.j) || 0;
                    if (sourceDegree < 3 || targetDegree < 3) {
                        addEdge(edge);
                    }
                });

                sortedPairs.forEach((edge) => {
                    const sourceDegree = degreeMap.get(edge.i) || 0;
                    const targetDegree = degreeMap.get(edge.j) || 0;
                    if (sourceDegree >= 4 && targetDegree >= 4) return;
                    if (edge.distance > Math.min(width, height) * 0.5) return;
                    addEdge(edge);
                });

                ctx.lineWidth = 1.25;
                edges.forEach((edge) => {
                    const startNode = positions[edge.i];
                    const endNode = positions[edge.j];
                    const dx = endNode.x - startNode.x;
                    const dy = endNode.y - startNode.y;
                    const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
                    if (!distance) return;

                    const ux = dx / distance;
                    const uy = dy / distance;
                    const startX = startNode.x + ux * nodeRadius;
                    const startY = startNode.y + uy * nodeRadius;
                    const endX = endNode.x - ux * nodeRadius;
                    const endY = endNode.y - uy * nodeRadius;

                    const alpha = Math.max(0.18, 0.48 - distance / Math.max(width, height));
                    const lineGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(startX, startY, endX, endY);
                    lineGradient.addColorStop(0, `rgba(118, 226, 255, ${alpha})`);
                    lineGradient.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${Math.min(alpha + 0.1, 0.4)})`);
                    lineGradient.addColorStop(1, `rgba(154, 121, 255, ${alpha})`);
                    ctx.strokeStyle = lineGradient;
                    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(105, 212, 255, 0.35)';
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(startX, startY);
                    ctx.lineTo(endX, endY);
                    ctx.stroke();
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

                    const progress = ((Date.now() / 1600) + (edge.i + edge.j) * 0.13) % 1;
                    const particleX = startX + (endX - startX) * progress;
                    const particleY = startY + (endY - startY) * progress;
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180, 240, 255, 0.85)';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(particleX, particleY, 1.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                });

                positions.forEach((item) => {
                    const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(item.x, item.y, 0, item.x, item.y, 26);
                    gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(89, 220, 255, 0.34)');
                    gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(89, 220, 255, 0)');
                    ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(item.x, item.y, 26, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();

                });

                $cloudNodes.innerHTML = positions.map((item, index) => {
                    const icon = item.agent.logoUrl
                        ? `<img src="${escapeHtml(item.agent.logoUrl)}" class="cloud-node-icon" alt="${escapeHtml(item.agent.name)}" onerror="this.outerHTML='<span class="cloud-node-icon">${escapeHtml(item.agent.icon || '🤖')}</span>';">`
                        : `<span class="cloud-node-icon">${escapeHtml(item.agent.icon || '🤖')}</span>`;

                    return `
                        <div class="cloud-node" style="left:${item.x - 23}px;top:${item.y}px;--duration:${9 + (index % 5)}s;--delay:${(index % 4) * 0.6}s;" title="${escapeHtml(item.agent.description || item.agent.name)}" onclick="openAgentFromCloud('${escapeHtml(item.agent.id)}')">
                            <div class="cloud-node-content">
                                ${icon}
                                <div class="cloud-node-label">
                                    <div class="cloud-node-name">${escapeHtml(item.agent.name)}</div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }).join('');
            }

            function dedupeAgentsByAic(list) {
                const seenKey = new Set();
                const seenName = new Set();
                const out = [];
                for (const agent of list || []) {
                    const aic = agent?.aic || '';
                    const name = (agent?.name || '').trim();
                    const key = aic || name || agent?.id || '';
                    if (!key) { out.push(agent); continue; }
                    if (seenKey.has(key)) continue;
                    if (name && seenName.has(name)) continue;
                    seenKey.add(key);
                    if (name) seenName.add(name);
                    out.push(agent);
                }
                return out;
            }

            function extractAgentsFromDiscoveryResult(data, fallbackType) {
                const result = data?.result || {};
                const acsMap = result.acsMap || {};
                const routes = Array.isArray(result.routes) ? result.routes : [];
                const routeSkills = routes
                    .flatMap(route => Array.isArray(route.agentGroups) ? route.agentGroups : [])
                    .flatMap(group => Array.isArray(group.agentSkills) ? group.agentSkills : []);

                const normalized = routeSkills.map((skillRef, index) => {
                    const acs = acsMap[skillRef.aic];
                    if (!acs) return null;

                    const firstEndpoint = Array.isArray(acs.endPoints) && acs.endPoints.length > 0
                        ? acs.endPoints[0]
                        : null;
                    const endpoint = firstEndpoint?.url || '';
                    const skill = Array.isArray(acs.skills)
                        ? acs.skills.find(item => item.id === skillRef.skillId) || acs.skills[0]
                        : null;
                    const hasEndpoints = Array.isArray(acs.endPoints) && acs.endPoints.length > 0;
                    const hasWebApp = Boolean(acs.webAppUrl);
                    const agentType = hasEndpoints ? 'ioa' : (hasWebApp ? 'web' : fallbackType);
                    const aic = acs.aic || skillRef.aic || '';
                    const recommendationId = [
                        aic,
                        skillRef.skillId || 'agent',
                        skillRef.ranking || index + 1
                    ].join('::');

                    return normalizeAgent({
                        id: recommendationId,
                        name: acs.name || '未命名智能体',
                        description: skill?.description || acs.description || '',
                        callMethod: firstEndpoint?.transport || (endpoint ? 'JSONRPC' : 'Web'),
                        type: agentType,
                        endpoint,
                        aic,
                        url: acs.webAppUrl || '',
                        iconUrl: acs.iconUrl || acs.logoUrl || '',
                        userQuery: skill?.examples?.[0] || '',
                        raw: {
                            acs,
                            skillRef,
                            skill
                        }
                    }, fallbackType);
                }).filter(Boolean);

                if (normalized.length > 0) {
                    return dedupeAgentsByAic(normalized);
                }

                return dedupeAgentsByAic(normalizeAgentList(result.agents || [], fallbackType));
            }

                try {

                    const response = await fetch(API_CONFIG.onlineStatusUrl, {

                            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        },
                        body: JSON.stringify({

                            limit: 5,
                            filter: {

                                ]
                            }
                        }),
                        cache: 'no-store',
                        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(API_CONFIG.timeout),

                    if (!response.ok) {

                        try {
                            const problem = await response.json();
                            detail = problem.detail || problem.message || '';
                        } catch (error) {}
                        throw new Error(detail || ('请求失败（HTTP ' + response.status + '）'));
                    }
                    const data = await response.json();

                    if (!acs && !aliveInfo) {

                        return;

                    }

                    showOnlineQueryState('error', '查询失败', error?.message || '在线状态服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试。');

                    if (submitButton) {
                        submitButton.disabled = false;
                        submitButton.textContent = originalButtonText;
                    }

            function normalizeRankingPayload(raw) {
                const wrapped = raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {};
                const root = wrapped.data && typeof wrapped.data === 'object'
                    ? wrapped.data
                    : (wrapped.result && typeof wrapped.result === 'object' ? wrapped.result : wrapped);
                const rankings = root.rankings && typeof root.rankings === 'object' ? root.rankings : {};
                const normalizeEntries = (items) => (Array.isArray(items) ? items : [])
                    .map((item) => {
                        const access = Number(item?.accessCount ?? item?.access_count ?? 0);
                        const message = Number(item?.messageCount ?? item?.message_count ?? 0);
                        return {
                            aic: String(item?.aic || item?.agentAic || item?.agent_aic || item?.id || '').trim(),
                            count: Number(item?.count ?? item?.taskCount ?? item?.task_count ?? (access + message)),
                            access,
                            message,
                        };
                    })
                    .filter((item) => item.aic && Number.isFinite(item.count));
                const entries = {};
                ['caller', 'callee', 'callerNonInternal', 'calleeNonInternal'].forEach((role) => {
                    entries[role] = normalizeEntries(root[role] || rankings[role]);
                });
                return {
                    entries,
                    timeRange: root.timeRange || root.time_range || null,
                    meta: root.meta || root.metadata || {},
                };
            }

            function mergeRankingEntries(role) {
                return [...(rankingPayloads.matched?.entries?.[role] || [])]

            function renderRanking() {
                if (!$rankingGrid) return;
                const role = $rankingRole?.value || 'callee';
                const ranking = mergeRankingEntries(role);
                const availablePayload = rankingPayloads.matched;
                const timeRange = rankingPayloads.matched?.timeRange || rankingRequestRange;
                $rankingTimeRange.textContent = formatRankingRange(timeRange);

                const missingHours = new Set();
                let currentHourOpen = false;
                const meta = rankingPayloads.matched?.meta || {};
                currentHourOpen = Boolean(meta.currentHourOpen ?? meta.current_hour_open);
                [meta.accessMissingHours, meta.access_missing_hours, meta.messageMissingHours, meta.message_missing_hours]
                    .forEach((missing) => {
                        if (Array.isArray(missing)) missing.forEach((hour) => missingHours.add(hour));
                    });

                $rankingMetaStatus.classList.toggle('warning', rankingFailures.length > 0 || missingHours.size > 0 || currentHourOpen);
                if (rankingFailures.length > 0) {
                    $rankingMetaStatus.textContent = '统计服务暂不可用';
                } else if (missingHours.size > 0) {
                    $rankingMetaStatus.textContent = '缺少 ' + missingHours.size + ' 个小时';

                    $rankingMetaStatus.textContent = '当前小时持续更新';

                    return;
                }
                const totalPages = Math.ceil(ranking.length / RANKING_CONFIG.pageSize);
                rankingCurrentPage = Math.min(Math.max(rankingCurrentPage, 1), totalPages);
                const pageStart = (rankingCurrentPage - 1) * RANKING_CONFIG.pageSize;
                const pageItems = ranking.slice(pageStart, pageStart + RANKING_CONFIG.pageSize);
                const rows = pageItems.map((item, index) => {

                    return '<article class="ranking-row rank-' + rank + '" role="listitem" title="' + escapeHtml(item.aic) + '">' +
                        '<span class="ranking-position">' + rank + '</span>' +
                        '<div class="ranking-main">' +
                            '<div class="ranking-aic">' + escapeHtml(item.aic) + '</div>' +
                            '<div class="ranking-sources">Access ' + item.access.toLocaleString('zh-CN') + ' · Message ' + item.message.toLocaleString('zh-CN') + '</div>' +
                        '</div>' +
                        '<div class="ranking-count">' + item.count.toLocaleString('zh-CN') + '<span class="ranking-unit">任务</span></div>' +
                    '</article>';
                }).join('');
                $rankingGrid.innerHTML =
                    '<div class="ranking-list-head" aria-hidden="true"><span>排名</span><span>智能体 AIC</span><span>任务数</span></div>' +
                    '<div class="ranking-rows" role="list">' + rows + '</div>' +
                    '<div class="ranking-pagination">' +
                        '<span class="ranking-page-info">共 ' + ranking.length + ' 条 · 第 ' + rankingCurrentPage + ' / ' + totalPages + ' 页</span>' +
                        '<div class="ranking-page-actions">' +
                            '<button class="ranking-page-button" type="button" data-ranking-page="prev"' + (rankingCurrentPage === 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>上一页</button>' +
                            '<button class="ranking-page-button" type="button" data-ranking-page="next"' + (rankingCurrentPage === totalPages ? ' disabled' : '') + '>下一页</button>' +
                        '</div>' +
                    '</div>';

                $rankingGrid.querySelector('[data-ranking-page="prev"]')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    rankingCurrentPage -= 1;
                    renderRanking();
                });
                $rankingGrid.querySelector('[data-ranking-page="next"]')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    rankingCurrentPage += 1;
                    renderRanking();
                });
            }

            async function loadRanking() {
                if (!$rankingGrid) return;
                rankingRequestRange = getRankingWindow();
                rankingFailures = [];
                rankingCurrentPage = 1;
                $rankingRefresh.disabled = true;
                $rankingMetaStatus.classList.remove('warning');
                $rankingMetaStatus.textContent = '正在汇总';
                $rankingGrid.innerHTML = '<div class="ranking-state"><strong>正在加载排行榜</strong>正在汇总直连调用与群组消息任务</div>';

                rankingPayloads = { matched: null };
                try {
                    const data = await fetchRankingEndpoint(API_CONFIG.matchedRankingUrl, rankingRequestRange);
                    rankingPayloads.matched = normalizeRankingPayload(data);
                } catch (error) {
                    rankingFailures.push({ source: 'matched', message: error?.message || '请求失败' });
                }
                renderRanking();
                $rankingRefresh.disabled = false;
            }

            function initRanking() {
                $rankingRole?.addEventListener('change', () => {
                    rankingCurrentPage = 1;
                    renderRanking();
                });
                $rankingRefresh?.addEventListener('click', loadRanking);
            }

            function buildCardHTML(agent, type) {
                const logoHtml = agent.logoUrl ?
                    `<img src="${escapeHtml(agent.logoUrl)}" class="card-logo" alt="${escapeHtml(agent.name)}" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.nextElementSibling.style.display='block';">` : '';
                const iconHtml = !agent.logoUrl ? `<span class="card-icon-fallback">${agent.icon || '🤖'}</span>` : '';
                return `
                <div class="card" data-search="${escapeHtml(agent.name + ' ' + agent.description).toLowerCase()}" onclick="openAgentFromCard('${escapeHtml(agent.id)}', '${type}')" title="${escapeHtml(agent.description)}">
                    <span class="card-badge ${type==='new'?'badge-new':'badge-hot'}">${type==='new'?'NEW':'HOT'}</span>
                    ${logoHtml}
                    ${iconHtml}
                    <div class="card-name">${escapeHtml(agent.name)}</div>
                    <div class="card-hover">
                        <div class="card-hover-title">${escapeHtml(agent.name)}</div>
                        <div class="card-hover-desc">${escapeHtml(agent.description || '暂无描述')}</div>
                        <div class="card-hover-aic">${escapeHtml(agent.aic || '')}</div>
                    </div>
                </div>`;
            }

            async function loadNewAgents() {
                let data = await fetchData(API_CONFIG.newAgentsUrl, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'accept': 'application/json',
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        type: DISCOVERY_REQUESTS.new.type,
                        limit: DISCOVERY_REQUESTS.new.limit,
                    })
                });

                let agents = data ? extractAgentsFromDiscoveryResult(data, 'ioa') : [];

                if (agents.length === 0 && API_CONFIG.useMockFallback) {
                    agents = normalizeAgentList(mockNewAgents, 'ioa');
                }

                if (agents.length > 0) {
                    newAgents = agents;
                    renderGrid($newGrid, newAgents, 'new', $newEmpty);
                }
            }

            async function loadHotAgents() {
                let data = await fetchData(API_CONFIG.hotAgentsUrl, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'accept': 'application/json',
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        type: DISCOVERY_REQUESTS.hot.type,
                        limit: DISCOVERY_REQUESTS.hot.limit,
                    })
                });

                let agents = data ? extractAgentsFromDiscoveryResult(data, 'ioa') : [];

                if (agents.length === 0 && API_CONFIG.useMockFallback) {
                    agents = normalizeAgentList(mockHotAgents, 'ioa');
                }

                if (agents.length > 0) {
                    hotAgents = agents;
                    renderGrid($hotGrid, hotAgents, 'hot', $hotEmpty);
                }
            }


            function renderGrid(gridEl, agents, type, emptyEl) {
                // 清空网格，但保留空状态元素
                const cardsHTML = agents.map(agent => buildCardHTML(agent, type)).join('');
                gridEl.innerHTML = cardsHTML;
                // 重新附加空状态元素（如果不存在则创建）
                if (!gridEl.querySelector('.empty-state')) {
                    const emptyDiv = document.createElement('div');
                    emptyDiv.className = 'empty-state';
                    emptyDiv.id = emptyEl.id;
                    emptyDiv.textContent = emptyEl.textContent;
                    gridEl.appendChild(emptyDiv);
                }
                // 初始显示所有卡片，隐藏空状态
                gridEl.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('hidden'));
                const empty = gridEl.querySelector('.empty-state');
                if (empty) empty.style.display = 'none';
                // 更新 emptyEl 引用
                if (emptyEl) {
                    const newEmpty = gridEl.querySelector('.empty-state');
                    if (newEmpty) window[emptyEl.id] = newEmpty;
                }
            }

            // 搜索过滤：基于data-search属性显示/隐藏卡片
            window.handleSearch = function(val) {
                const filter = val.trim().toLowerCase();
                const filterGrid = (gridEl, emptyEl) => {
                    const cards = gridEl.querySelectorAll('.card');
                    let visibleCount = 0;
                    cards.forEach(card => {
                        const searchText = card.getAttribute('data-search') || '';
                        if (!filter || searchText.includes(filter)) {
                            card.classList.remove('hidden');
                            visibleCount++;
                        } else {
                            card.classList.add('hidden');
                        }
                    });
                    const empty = gridEl.querySelector('.empty-state');
                    if (empty) {
                        empty.style.display = visibleCount === 0 ? 'block' : 'none';
                    }
                };
                filterGrid($newGrid, $newEmpty);
                filterGrid($hotGrid, $hotEmpty);
            };

            window.searchInDingdang = function(agentName) {
                logBridge('回退为搜索', agentName);
                switchTab('dingdang');
                const iframe = document.getElementById('dingdangFrame');
                if (iframe) {
                    const targetUrl = `${TAB_URLS.dingdang}?q=${encodeURIComponent(agentName)}`;
                    iframeReady = false;
                    iframe.src = targetUrl;
                    iframe.addEventListener('load', () => {
                        iframeReady = true;
                        iframe.contentWindow?.postMessage({
                            type: 'agent:selected',
                            payload: { name: agentName }
                        }, BRIDGE_CONFIG.targetOrigin);
                    }, { once: true });
                }
                showToast(`正在叮当中搜索：${agentName}`, 'info');
            };

            window.openAgentFromCard = async function(agentId, sectionType) {
                const list = sectionType === 'new' ? newAgents : hotAgents;
                const agent = list.find(item => item.id === agentId);
                if (!agent) {
                    showToast('未找到智能体数据', 'info');
                    return;
                }

                logBridge('点击智能体卡片', {
                    agentId,
                    sectionType,
                    agent
                });

                switchTab('dingdang');
                if (!isBridgeReady(agent)) {
                    logBridge('缺少桥接字段，无法直连', {
                        name: agent.name,
                        type: agent.type,
                        endpoint: agent.endpoint,
                        aic: agent.aic,
                        url: agent.url
                    });
                    if (BRIDGE_CONFIG.fallbackToSearch) {
                        window.searchInDingdang(agent.name);
                    }
                    return;
                }

                try {
                    const iframe = document.getElementById('dingdangFrame');
                    if (iframe && !window.DingdangEmbedBridge?.isFrameAtTarget(iframe, TAB_URLS.dingdang)) {
                        logBridge('切回 dingdang iframe 页面');
                        iframeReady = false;
                        iframe.src = TAB_URLS.dingdang;
                    }

                    const result = await postAgentToDingdangWithAck(agent);
                    const modeText = result?.mode === 'web' ? '应用展示' : '执行调用';
                    showToast(`已发送到叮当：${agent.name}（${modeText}）`, 'success');
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('Bridge invoke failed:', error);
                    showToast(`桥接失败，回退为搜索：${agent.name}`, 'info');
                    if (BRIDGE_CONFIG.fallbackToSearch) {
                        window.searchInDingdang(agent.name);
                    }
                }
            };

            window.openAgentFromCloud = function(agentId) {
                const agent = [...hotAgents, ...newAgents].find(item => item.id === agentId);
                openAgent(agent);
            };

            window.switchTab = function(tabId) {
                if (currentTab === tabId) return;
                document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
                    btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.tab === tabId);
                });
                currentTab = tabId;
                iframeReady = false;
                $iframeContainer.innerHTML = `<iframe id="dingdangFrame" src="${TAB_URLS[tabId]}" title="${tabId}" allow="clipboard-write"></iframe>`;
                markIframeReadyOnce(document.getElementById('dingdangFrame'));
            };

            window.refreshNewAgents = async () => {
                $newGrid.innerHTML = '<div class="card" style="grid-column:1/-1;">刷新中...</div>';
                await loadNewAgents();
                // 重新应用当前搜索
                handleSearch(document.getElementById('searchInput')?.value || '');
                showToast('已为您寻找到最新上线智能体', 'success');
            };
            window.refreshHotAgents = async () => {
                $hotGrid.innerHTML = '<div class="card" style="grid-column:1/-1;">刷新中...</div>';
                await loadHotAgents();
                handleSearch(document.getElementById('searchInput')?.value || '');
                showToast('已为您寻找到当前热门智能体', 'success');
            };

            async function loadPartners() {
                let data = await fetchData(API_CONFIG.partnersUrl);
                if (!data && API_CONFIG.useMockFallback) data = mockPartners;
                if (data && data.partners) {
                    const label = document.createElement('span');
                    label.className = 'footer-label';
                    label.textContent = '🤝 合作单位';
                    $partnerFooter.innerHTML = '';
                    $partnerFooter.appendChild(label);
                    data.partners.forEach(p => {
                        const box = document.createElement('div');
                        box.className = 'logo-box';
                        box.title = p.name;
                        box.onclick = () => { if(p.link) window.open(p.link, '_blank'); };
                        if(p.logoUrl) {
                            const img = document.createElement('img');
                            img.src = p.logoUrl;
                            img.alt = p.name;
                            img.onload = () => {
                                if (img.naturalWidth / Math.max(img.naturalHeight, 1) > 2.8) {
                                    box.classList.add('logo-box-wide');
                                }
                            };
                            img.onerror = () => { box.textContent = p.name; };
                            box.appendChild(img);
                        } else {
                            box.textContent = p.name;
                        }
                        $partnerFooter.appendChild(box);
                    });
                    enableDragScroll($partnerFooter);
                }
            }

            function initResizableSidebar() {
                if (!$container || !$sidebar || !$resizeHandle) return;

                const savedWidth = Number(localStorage.getItem('dingdangSidebarWidth'));
                if (savedWidth) setSidebarWidth(savedWidth);

                let startX = 0;
                let startWidth = 0;

                function getWidthBounds() {
                    const containerWidth = $container.getBoundingClientRect().width;
                    const minSidebarWidth = 320;
                    const minMainWidth = 360;
                    const maxSidebarWidth = Math.max(minSidebarWidth, containerWidth - minMainWidth - 34);
                    return { minSidebarWidth, maxSidebarWidth };
                }

                function setSidebarWidth(width) {
                    const { minSidebarWidth, maxSidebarWidth } = getWidthBounds();
                    const nextWidth = Math.min(Math.max(width, minSidebarWidth), maxSidebarWidth);
                    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--sidebar-width', `${nextWidth}px`);
                    $resizeHandle.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', Math.round(nextWidth));
                    return nextWidth;
                }

                $resizeHandle.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
                    if (window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)').matches) return;
                    startX = event.clientX;
                    startWidth = $sidebar.getBoundingClientRect().width;
                    document.body.classList.add('resizing-sidebar');
                    $resizeHandle.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
                    event.preventDefault();
                });

                $resizeHandle.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
                    if (!document.body.classList.contains('resizing-sidebar')) return;
                    const deltaX = event.clientX - startX;
                    setSidebarWidth(startWidth - deltaX);
                });

                function stopResize(event) {
                    if (!document.body.classList.contains('resizing-sidebar')) return;
                    document.body.classList.remove('resizing-sidebar');
                    localStorage.setItem('dingdangSidebarWidth', Math.round($sidebar.getBoundingClientRect().width));
                    if ($resizeHandle.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {
                        $resizeHandle.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
                    }
                }

                $resizeHandle.addEventListener('pointerup', stopResize);
                $resizeHandle.addEventListener('pointercancel', stopResize);
                window.addEventListener('resize', () => setSidebarWidth($sidebar.getBoundingClientRect().width));
            }

            function initCloudResizeObserver() {
                if (!$cloudWrap || typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') {
                    window.addEventListener('resize', renderAgentCloud);
                    return;
                }
                const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => renderAgentCloud());
                observer.observe($cloudWrap);
                window.addEventListener('resize', renderAgentCloud);
            }

            function enableDragScroll(element) {
                let isDown = false;
                let startX, scrollLeft;
                element.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
                    isDown = true;
                    element.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
                    startX = e.pageX - element.offsetLeft;
                    scrollLeft = element.scrollLeft;
                });
                element.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                    isDown = false;
                    element.style.cursor = 'grab';
                });
                element.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
                    isDown = false;
                    element.style.cursor = 'grab';
                });
                element.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                    if (!isDown) return;
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const x = e.pageX - element.offsetLeft;
                    const walk = (x - startX) * 1.5;
                    element.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - walk;
                });
            }

            // 初始化骨架（加载前占位）
            function initSkeleton() {
                $newGrid.innerHTML = Array(6).fill('<div class="card card-loading"></div>').join('') + '<div class="empty-state">暂无匹配的最新上线智能体</div>';
                $hotGrid.innerHTML = Array(6).fill('<div class="card card-loading"></div>').join('') + '<div class="empty-state">暂无匹配的热门智能体</div>';
            }
            initSkeleton();
            initWelcomeOverlay();
            initSidebarHelpPopover();
            initCollapsibleSections();
            initOnlineStatusQuery();
            initRanking();
            initResizableSidebar();
            markIframeReadyOnce(document.getElementById('dingdangFrame'));

            async function init() {
                await Promise.all([loadRanking(), loadNewAgents(), loadHotAgents(), loadPartners(), loadActiveAgentCount()]);
                window.setInterval(loadActiveAgentCount, 30000);
                console.log('✅ 平台就绪');
            }
            init().catch(console.error);
        })();
    </script>
